data.name: San Diego Whale Watching Cruise
data.headline: Guaranteed sightings or your next trip free! | 3 to 3.5 Hours | Mid-Dec to Mid-Apr
data.description:
#*Gain a deeper understanding of the ocean ecosystem and enjoy live commentary on the area's sights and sea creatures!.*

- Approximately 3.5 hours
- Mid-December - Mid-April; Daily (Weather Permitting)

**Departures:** 9:30am & 1:30pm 

Location: 990 N. Harbor Drive, San Diego
data.highlights:
San Diego ranks among the world's most incredible places for viewing marine wildlife. Between December and April, more than 20,000 gray whales migrate along our coast. For the thrill of a lifetime, cruise alongside these magnificent whales in their natural environment with Flagship Cruises, San Diego's most experienced whale watching company.

Flagship's history traces back to the world's first whale watching cruise—right here in San Diego in 1955. Gain a deeper understanding of the ocean ecosystem and enjoy live commentary on the sights and sea creatures you may encounter: gray whales, fin whales, humpbacks, minke whales, dolphins, sea lions and more.

**Best of all, whale sightings are guaranteed. If you do not see a whale, your next trip is free!**

Tours depart twice daily aboard our comfortable, two-story whale watching yacht, with spacious open-air sundeck,  multiple restrooms and free guest WiFi. 

Flagship's whale watching cruises are educational and fun for the whole family. The incredible connection with nature will leave a lasting impression. Reservations recommended.

#Reservations Policy
Reservations are non-refundable. Please provide Flagship with 24-hour notice prior to the cruise date to reschedule your cruise to another time and date.
data.booking_notes:
#Details
•Flagship will gladly add additional tickets to your existing reservation. If you desire to be seated with someone who holds an existing reservation, our reservation department would be pleased to accommodate your request, call us at 1-619-234-4111.
•Our Captains & Crews want you to enjoy your experience with Flagship. Please be aware, parking downtown is limited.  Please be sure to allow enough travel time to arrive at our docks 30 minutes before your scheduled departure time.
•Flagship Cruises & Events accepts no responsibility for loss, damaged or stolen property on board our vessels or on premises.

#Taxes and Fees
• Fees - A  6% convenience fee charged for the convenience of booking online.

#Additional Info
Flagship's Whale Watching Tours are a **cashless** activity. Please bring a digital method of payment to purchase items at the snack bar on the vessel. Acceptable methods of payment include: Apple Pay, Google Pay, Credit & Debit Cards.

*•It is recommended that you dress is layers, wear comfortable (closed toe) shoes, hat and sunglasses.*
*•If you are prone to motion sickness, please make sure you take a product like Dramamine BEFORE you arrive.*

Your experience is important to us. If you have any questions regarding this confirmation or your reservation, please contact our reservation department at 1-619-234-4111 during regular business hours 8am – 5:30pm PST daily.

On behalf of our entire crew…WELCOME ABOARD Flagship Cruises & Events!
